scientific_integrity: Deterministic proof for every finite dimension and horizon; numerical replay is supplementary. Original DGDA method and its parameters are credited to Zheng et al.
scientific_limitations: Equal nonzero singular values, square real bilinear games, the indicated fixed parameters and Euclidean product norms. Does not cover other step parameters, ill-conditioned games, arbitrary initializations for the synchronized-variable formula, or global divergence.
title: Sharp transient amplification in critically damped bilinear descent-ascent
